args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build of tests/test_money.py failed because round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP while FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN).

- Updated src/money.py to import and apply ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (the docstring already stated banker's rounding; only the implementation was wrong).

## Test plan
- CI run ci-0001 on this branch (08d3cd5986) passed, including tests/test_money.py::test_half_even.
args.head: fix/round-half-even-FIN-212

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis**: `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while its docstring and FIN-212 (and the tests) required banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) — this was the cause of the nightly test failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
- **Fix**: Created branch `fix/round-half-even-FIN-212` and changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `Decimal.quantize`.
- **CI**: Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch — it **passed**.
- **PR**: Opened PR #101 against main ("Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212") with **alex** requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is now awaiting alex's review; merging will need code-owner approval per policy.
